fees.source: https://watermelonpark.com/ ('Daily Site Rates': A Row (0-32 ft) $60, B Row (26-36 ft) $60; C and D rows for 37-100 ft $80 / $100) + https://watermelonpark.com/camping-cancellation-policy/ ('full refund minus the $3.75 reservation fee'), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://watermelonpark.com/ ('All sites include water, 30 & 50 amp electric service'; 'none of our sites have sewer hookups due to our proximity to the river'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Nightly sites in four rows chosen by RV length: A (0-32 ft), B (26-36 ft), C and D (37-100 ft). Monthly sites besides.

sites.source: https://watermelonpark.com/ ('Daily Site Rates' by row and RV length), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Free dump station; a honey truck pumps out campers for $30 (Monday-Saturday). A bathhouse for all guests.

facilities.source: https://watermelonpark.com/ ('we offer a convenient dump station available at no additional charge'; 'A bathhouse is available for all guests'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Online through Firefly Reservations ('Make a campground reservation'). $3.75 reservation fee. Daily campers: full refund less that fee up to 48 hours before check-in, none after; Memorial Day, Fourth of July and Labor Day weekends add a $50 cancellation fee (waived if rescheduled within the summer).

summary: Confirmed $60 for the rows a 23-ft rig uses (A/B), added the $3.75 reservation fee; added water + 30/50-amp at every site and no sewer, rows up to 100 ft, free dump station (a bathhouse, showers not named), Firefly online booking and cancellation terms. Not stated: season, site count, pull-throughs, minimum stay. The rate table still carries no year (page footer (c)2026).
